items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: Uh, very much like, uh, Blind Lemon, and, uh, in a way, Lead Belly.

ctx.x: And then the guitar would fit in with this. Now, how would you characterize the guitar style?

Uh, very much like, uh, Blind Lemon, and, uh, in a way, Lead Belly. Although I don't remember the 12th string, I don't think. I don't remember it. It might have been there. And there was somebody who would lead, uh, he did it unentrusively, so that you scarcely noticed it, Blind Lemon around, but I don't remember who that was at all, or have any idea. I know there was somebody there, but this is all very vague in my mind. I don't recall. The guitarist would play kind of a wandering, very freestyle, with a, not…
Hmm. This, uh, you indicated, ended by the time you were about 10.
